test_stimuli.name: nominal_time
test_stimuli.derivation: BCD bytes: 0x15=15 sec, 0x30=30 min, 0x09=9 hr, 0x03=3 day, 0x15=15 date, 0x06=6 month, 0x23=23 year. year+2000=2023.

test_stimuli.name: zero_time
test_stimuli.derivation: BCD bytes: 0x00=0 sec, 0x00=0 min, 0x00=0 hr, 0x01=1 day, 0x01=1 date, 0x01=1 month, 0x00=0 year. year+2000=2000.
